pages.text: Ocean waves churning over unknown depths. Rushing rivers and placid lakes. Water spirits can slake your thirst or drown you.

When a water shrine is overfilled, excess water spirits will manifest as water (the same number of water spirits as a water bucket has). Likewise, overdrawing will destroy water for spirits (flowing water only yields one spirit). Unlike a fire shrine with lava, a water shrine can affect multiple blocks every time it is overfilled or overdrawn, potentially creating or destroying large amounts of water at once.
